name: /start replies with welcome and command list

payload.text:
Welcome! I am ready to help.

Available commands:
/start - Welcome message
/ping - Ping the bot (e.g. /ping)
/help - Show this help (e.g. /help)
/c2f - Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit (e.g. /c2f 25)
/f2c - Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius (e.g. /f2c 77)
